J1.direction_source: TE drawing 776163 rev K1 (telemetry-pod/expansion/connector-candidate/sources/776163-K1.pdf, sha256 7ed1f2a5f6ebf57aeaefefa4b2bf5c165de0343a4317719d7771c2aabbc285a7): sheet 1 section A-A and sheet 2 isometric 'AMPSEAL HEADER' / 'RECOMMENDED P.C. In the footprint frame (F, rotation 0; pad 1 y=51.5, pad 35 y=59.5 in iter8n/iter8s) that is outward y+.
